repairedTest.name: plane keeps finite terrain/rim guards and rejects bad stage contacts without losing accepted work
repairedTest.cause: The contact vector returned by the binding is an owned copy. Editing its contact did not corrupt native data, so the supposed injected failure never occurred.
repairedTest.correction: Inject an inconsistent derived plane height in the actual stage geom_xpos view. The plane gap guard rejects it and restores the exact accepted frame/work prefix.
repairedTest.verifiedBy: Final 17-test focused regression in this receipt; also checks nonfinite plane height.
